Packing Tips for Moving

Simple packing habits that reduce damage and stress.

Author: Ralph Ivey

Last updated: 2026-07-20

Experience: Written for working trucking and moving businesses.

Answer

Pack by room, label clearly, protect fragile items, and avoid overfilling boxes.
